lines: Did you finally open your eyes?
Then why don’t you even meet my gaze?
You scold, “You’re late.”
Even so, I’ve rushed forward as far as I could.
My heart has already overtaken my body.
Just your hair and those eyes make my chest ache.
I inhale the same moment and refuse to let it go.
To that voice I have known since ages past.
For the first time in my life, what should I say?
Since your far‑past lives, I have begun searching for you.
I came aiming at that clumsy way you laugh.
Even if you lose everything and become scattered to bits.
I won’t hesitate any longer; I’ll start searching again from the beginning.
Perhaps we should start the universe anew from zero.
I wonder where to begin.
The story that unfolded while you slept.
I’ve come to tell a tale spanning billions of light‑years.
But now, when that form reflects in my eyes—
I want to frolic, colliding with the you you don’t even know.
I want to love even your undying pain.
We met at the edge of countless galaxies.
How should I hold that hand without breaking it?
Since your far‑past lives, I have begun searching for you.
I came aiming at that noisy voice and its tears.
Who could possibly stop us on the eve of such a revolution?
No longer wavering, I’ll plant a flag in your heart.
You stole the way to give up from me.
